name: Sovol SV07
notes: Build volume, nozzle and filament size are Sovol's published specs. Speeds, flow and efficiency are starting values for estimates, not Sovol's slicer profile. Calibrate with timeFactor in Settings > Print estimates.
sources: Sovol SV07 product page: 220 x 220 x 250 mm build volume, Klipper firmware, 0.4 mm nozzle, 1.75 mm filament

webcam.note: Mainsail default paths for a crowsnest / mjpg-streamer camera on the printer's web port (80). Used only when Moonraker lists no webcam. Not checked on a real SV07 yet.
